name: The One
source:
LoveCorp finds everyone their soulmate. Everyone. But that all changes when you uncover a conspiracy that runs deeper than you could have imagined.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
LoveCorp发现每个人都是他们的灵魂伴侣。每个人。但当你揭开一个比你想象的更深的阴谋时，一切都会改变。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]Choices Wikia[/url]]
